en.topic_title: ‘Groundless speculation’: China denies spying on Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
en.topic_summary:
Beijing dismissed as “groundless speculation” on Friday a report that said Jensen Huang, head of US chip giant Nvidia, was the target of a Chinese spy plot.



Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang. File photo: Nvidia.
